subject: Cantina method refresh: inspect final mask and inherited face/reference preparation
body:
Method refresh following the final QA concern: root saved the attached primary-source research and actual v004 audit. The strict final mask may restore away Ford identity even if raw generation is better; only the final composite was saved, so raw likeness remains unknown.

Two inherited input questions need inspection before another sampler: Comfy supplies a facial-landmark image while Wan's own preprocessing uses aligned RGB face crops; the donor's VAE aspect preparation also differs from its uncropped CLIP branch. These are investigation targets, not proven causes. FaceFusion, ReActor and DreamID-V are candidates for a dedicated identity comparison; their Cloud nodes/models and effective inputs remain unverified.

Next: inspect actual donor/lead-face preparation and attempt read-only recovery of raw cached generation, then choose one deliberate treatment. No new render, installation or model import occurred in this refresh. The proof remains Preliminary/unaccepted, with the F198 eye-expression and weak Ford-likeness concerns intact. Please surface this update to Ziggy when active. Native direct relay remains broken; this file is posted locally, with delivery, reading and wakeup unconfirmed.
